title: Managed Backup: invoice minimum
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines invoice minimum.

## Tier basis

**Minimum invoice amount.** Minimum positive monthly invoice total; USD decimal, smaller totals carry forward.

| Contract tier | Minimum invoice amount |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 0.5 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, minimum invoice amount is 0.5.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, minimum invoice amount stays the same.
